analogy.rationale: Thiazides inhibit the Na-Cl cotransporter in the distal tubule, but the measured cell lines are not renal tubule cells and express little of the target; the closest transcriptional overlap would come from other ion-transport or carbonic-anhydrase inhibitors, though overall response should be weak.
